extracted.name: Brussels sprout slaw
extracted.description: Use up any extra brussels sprouts in your veg box this winter by making this sprout slaw. It will go particularly well with cold cuts on Boxing Day
ingredient_lines: 1 carrot sliced into thin strips or coarsely grated
¼ red cabbage cored and shredded
small bunch of chives parsley or dill, roughly snipped or torn
2 tsp apple cider vinegar or any other vinegar
instruction_lines: Put the sprouts, onion, carrot, cabbage, celery seeds and all but a small handful of the herbs in a bowl, and mix well to combine.

Put the yogurt, mayo, mustard, vinegar and seasoning in a small bowl and mix well. Spoon the dressing over the vegetables, then toss everything well to coat. Taste for seasoning. Spoon the slaw into a serving bowl or onto a platter, and scatter over the remaining herbs to serve.
